name: rule-lead-reads-as-asked
why: orchestrate-issues' own GitHub reads and issue writes, against themselves.

job.purpose:
gh api GET repos/discobox-ai/discobox/pulls (with query parameters), repos/discobox-ai/discobox/pulls/<number>, repos/discobox-ai/discobox/pulls/<number>/files, repos/discobox-ai/discobox/branches (with query parameters): list and read pull requests and branches
gh api GET repos/discobox-ai/discobox/pulls/<number>/reviews and repos/discobox-ai/discobox/pulls/<number>/comments: read the reviews and review comments on pull requests
gh api GET repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/<number> and repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/<number>/comments: read issues
gh api GET repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues (with query parameters): list open issues, to find the untriaged ones
gh api POST repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues with a title and body, and POST repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/<number>/comments with a body: file an issue for work I hand to a discobox, and comment on an issue
gh api GET repos/discobox-ai/discobox/actions/runs (with query parameters such as branch=main), actions/runs/<id>, actions/runs/<id>/jobs and actions/jobs/<id>/logs: read CI runs, their jobs and job logs
gh api GET repos/discobox-ai/discobox/commits/<sha>/check-runs and commits/<sha>/status (with query parameters): read the checks on a commit
